execution_assumptions: The audit callback must run on the classical host, exactly in input order.
Every event affects the digest; each intermediate audit digest is observable.
The one-pass full ledger is the required output contract; there is no hidden existential query.
input_domain: events is a finite list of bytes; audit is a callback with externally visible effects and may raise.
software_contract: Consume every event in order, call audit exactly once per event, and return the final rolling digest.
title: Ordered ledger digest
